title: Evaluation of the binarized circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose each gate has pairwise distinct arguments and every negation gate has exactly one argument. For every assignment $x$ of Boolean values to the inputs, the circuit obtained by binarizing $C$ has the same output as $C$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Each gate has pairwise distinct arguments
Each negation gate has exactly one argument
x assigns a Boolean value to each of the n inputs
